free_tier.stated: 'Search Mega.nz with speed, clarity, and confidence.' Free index of Mega links with size, type and context shown before opening.
free_tier.notes: No query cap is published on the page read.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an index of links

retention.stated: not applicable: results point at Mega.nz files under Mega's own retention

egress.terms: Nothing is transferred by Wafile; a result downloads from Mega, which applies its own free-tier transfer quota.

interface_detail: Web search form. No API is published on the page read.
chaining: A Mega-only index, so it pairs with Mega-download tooling (megatools, MEGAcmd) rather than with a debrid: debrids generally refuse Mega links or resolve them slowly. The site claims a 24-hour index refresh and a 4-hour status recheck.

limits.value: unstated; '24/7 Index refresh' and '4h Status recheck' are the only cadence figures

binding_note: An index transfers nothing, so no byte constraint binds. The first real limit is Mega's own transfer quota on the download.

identity_cost.detail: No account or login on the search form.

reliability_note: The 4-hour status recheck means a dead Mega link can still be listed as alive for most of a day.
confidence_note: The Mega focus and the refresh cadence are read from the vendor page today. No query was run, so coverage is unmeasured.

evidence.proved: 'Search Mega.nz with speed, clarity, and confidence', '24/7 Index refresh', '4h Status recheck', and the promise to show 'file size, type, and context before opening'

notes: One of three Mega-specific search engines named by the aggregators lane (meganz.net, meganz.net/zippysharedjs, this). SearchFiles is the general index; this is the single-host one.
